title: Microsoft Edge: auto-open Copilot side pane for links opened from Outlook
summary: The roadmap facts, policy paths, registry settings and documented defaults are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting statements about policy availability and cite the page identifying Copilot Chat in the Edge side pane; feature-specific licensing remains unpublished.

claims.claim: Microsoft Edge plans to open the Copilot side pane automatically for links opened from Outlook.
claims.quote: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The policy reference says the auto-open policy is not yet supported, so its behaviour is described as planned.
claims.quote: This policy is not yet supported. When support becomes available, eligible links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant can open with the Copilot side pane.
claims.fix: After the not-yet-supported statement, add: 'Microsoft's Intune June 8, 2026 release notes describe automatic opening from Edge 148 in present terms, while the policy reference still says it is not yet supported and the roadmap remains In development.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/whats-new/#week-of-june-8,-2026-service-release-2605, which says: 'Starting in Microsoft Edge version 148, when users open eligible links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant, Microsoft Edge automatically opens the Copilot side pane with contextual insights.'

claims.claim: The policy page does not define which Outlook links are eligible.
claims.quote: Searched: M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled eligible web links definition supported links; read the full M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled reference and Intune June 8, 2026 excerpts. Neither defines eligibility.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: The auto-open policy's unconfigured default is on.
claims.quote: If you enable this policy or don't configure it, the Copilot side pane opens automatically when users open eligible links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant.

claims.claim: Enabling M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled makes the pane open automatically for eligible same-tenant Outlook links.
claims.quote: If you enable this policy or don't configure it, the Copilot side pane opens automatically when users open eligible links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Disabling M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled prevents the pane from opening automatically for those links.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, the Copilot side pane doesn't open automatically for those links.

claims.quote: Can be mandatory: Yes

claims.quote: Can be recommended: No

claims.quote: Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Automatically open Copilot side pane with contextual insights for links opened from Outlook.
claims.quote:
GP name: Automatically open Copilot side pane with contextual insights for links opened from Outlook
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge

claims.claim: The Windows registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled of type REG_DWORD.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext governs Copilot side-pane page-content access for users signed in to Edge with a Microsoft Entra account.
claims.quote: This policy applies only to users who are signed in to Microsoft Edge with a Microsoft Entra account and are using Copilot in the side pane.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Disabling EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext also disables the auto-open feature because it requires page-content access.
claims.quote: This also disables the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled feature, because Copilot requires page content access to provide contextual insights for Microsoft 365 links.

claims.claim: Unconfigured EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext enables access by default in non-EU regions.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:
Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.

claims.claim: Unconfigured EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext disables access by default in EU regions.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:
Access is disabled by default in EU regions.

claims.claim: When EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext is unconfigured, users can change the setting in Microsoft Edge settings.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:
Users can turn this setting on or off in Microsoft Edge settings.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot cannot access page content protected by DLP policies even when page access is enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot can't access page content on pages protected by data loss prevention (DLP) policies, even if this policy is enabled.

claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext applies per Edge profile, represented as user scope.
claims.quote: Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Control Copilot access to Microsoft Edge page content, browsing history, and video transcript for Entra account user profiles when using Copilot in the Microsoft Edge sidepane.

GP name: Control Copilot access to Microsoft Edge page content, browsing history, and video transcript for Entra account user profiles when using Copilot in the Microsoft Edge sidepane
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge

claims.claim: The Windows registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext of type REG_DWORD.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: CopilotPageContext governs Copilot side-pane page-content access for Microsoft Entra ID profiles.
claims.quote:
This policy controls whether Copilot in the Microsoft Edge side pane can access page content.
This policy applies only to Microsoft Entra ID profiles in Microsoft Edge.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling CopilotPageContext also disables the auto-open feature.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, Copilot can't access page content. This also disables the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled feature, because Copilot requires page content access to provide contextual insights for Microsoft 365 links.

claims.claim: CopilotPageContext does not control access for Copilot with enterprise data protection.
claims.quote: This policy doesn't control access for Copilot with enterprise data protection (EDP).

claims.claim: CopilotPageContext applies per Edge profile, represented as user scope.
claims.quote: Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Control Copilot access to page context for Microsoft Entra ID profiles.
claims.quote:
GP name: Control Copilot access to page context for Microsoft Entra ID profiles
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge

claims.claim: The Windows registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value CopilotPageContext of type REG_DWORD.
claims.quote:
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: CopilotPageContext
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext controls page-content access for Copilot with enterprise data protection.
claims.quote: Access for Copilot with EDP is controlled by the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext policy.

claims.claim: EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext covers Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in the Edge side pane.
claims.quote:
This chart covers the behavior of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business which is accessible in the sidepane.
Please use our EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext group policy to block Copilot’s access to page content in your tenant.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/edge-learnmore-copilot-page-summary-results to sources for the existing statement identifying Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in the Edge side pane.

claims.claim: Disabling a page-context policy removes page access for the Copilot side-pane contextual queries covered by that policy, not only automatic Outlook-link opening.
claims.quote:
This includes page summarization, video summarization, sharing an image with Copilot from the context menu ("Ask Copilot about this image"), and other contextual queries.
If you disable this policy, Copilot can't access page content, browsing history, or video transcript.

claims.claim: The policy page documents no separate control over how much of the originating email is used.
claims.quote: Searched: M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled originating email context policy amount control limit; read the complete auto-open, EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and CopilotPageContext references and Intune excerpts. No email-amount control is stated.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described what this feature's suggestion chips can do without user approval.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Edge Outlook auto open Copilot suggestion chips actions user approval confirmation; M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled eligible links email context limit control approval suggestion chips. Read auto-open reference and Intune excerpts; no chip approval semantics.
